title: Frappe ERPNext 6.26.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 6.26.0 before 15.121.4 and 16.x before 16.36.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in a Stock module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including those with minimal privileges or portal users, to access stock data they should not be authorized to see. Attackers can query out-of-scope records to obtain per-warehouse and company-wide stock quantities and confirm the existence of items.
